value.rationale: Identifies the exact no-reentry positivity regime for weak higher-order perturbations on all fixed positively weighted diameter-two graph networks, with a universal first-order time and explicit nonedge competition governed by weighted three-step Laplacian structure. This is a natural stability question for higher-order diffusion; the graph-sensitive correction and global all-time sign guarantee are not merely a finite numeric exercise.
